title: Bato lawyer slams P50M bounty: 'It invites people to take law into their own hands'
summary: The legal counsel of Sen. Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa slammed newspaper columnist Mon Tulfo and his support for the P50-million bounty placed by the government for the senator's arrest.
